arabic text: UMMUL BANIN SA\nPAHUNCHAY SIRHANE BHAI KE JAB SHAHE KARBALA\nGHAZI NE APNI AAKHRI SAANSON MAY DI SADA
english translation text: WHEN IMAM HUSAYN AS REACHED BY\nTHE BODY OF ABAL FADHL HAZRAT\nABBAS IN HIS LAST BREATH SAID THIS

arabic text: UMMUL BANIN SA\nMAULA MAA UMMUL BANEEN SE MAT KEHNA
english translation text: OH MY MASTER, DON'T\nTELL MY MOTHER UMMUL BANEEN

arabic text: UMMUL BANIN SA\nSHARMINDA SAKINA SE HO BAHOT\nMAI PANI LEKAR AA NA SAKA
english translation text: THAT I AM ASHAMED\nTHAT I COULDN'T BRING\nWATER FOR SAKINA

arabic text: MAA NE JO SIKHAYE BACHPAN ME WO YAAD HAI SAB AADAAB MUJHE NAZDEEK KHADE REHNA US JA\nSHABBIR JAHAN BAITHE JAAKE
english translation text: WHAT MY MOTHER TAUGHT ME WHEN I WAS YOUNG, I HAVE REMEMBERED ALL THOSE HABITS\n'GO AND STAND NEARBY WHERE SHABBIR IS SITTING'

arabic text: IS WAQT MAGAR KHADIM TERA,\nTAAZEEM KO TERI UTH NA SAKA\nMAULA MAA UMMUL BANEEN SE MAT KEHNA
english translation text: BUT RIGHT NOW, THIS SLAVE OF YOURS CAN'T\nEVEN STAND UP IN YOUR HONOR OH MY\nMASTER, DON'T TELL MY MOTHER UMMUL BANEEN

arabic text: HAR LAASH PE GIRKE KEHTE THAY, KYA TUM HI ALI KE BETE HO\nMALOOM HAI KITNI MUSHKIL MAY, KHAIMO SE YAHAN TAK PAHUNCHAY HO
english translation text: HE FELL ONTO EVERY BODY AND ASKED, ARE YOU THE SON OF ALI\nI KNOW WITH SO MUCH TROUBLE, YOU HAVE COME FROM THE TENTS TO HERE

arabic text: ABBAS SE MILNE KI KHAATIR, ZEHMAT JO UTHAYI HAI MAULA\nMAULA MAA UMMUL BANEEN SE MAT KEHNA
english translation text: TO MEET ABBAS, YOU HAVE ENDURED A LOT OF TROUBLE\nMY MASTER, OH MY MASTER, DON'T TELL MY MOTHER UMMUL BANEEN

arabic text: KIS TARHA KATAY BAAZU MERE, MAQTAL MAY BATA DENA BESHAK\nMAI ZEE SE ZAMEEN PAR KAISE GIRA, AMMA KO SUNA DENA BESHAK
english translation text: HOW MY ARMS WERE CUT, IN THE BATTLEFIELD, TELL HER THAT FOR SURE\nHOW I FELL FROM MY HORSE TO THE GROUND, TELL HER THAT FOR SURE

arabic text: ABBAS KE GIRNE SE LEKIN, ZAINAB KE GIRI THI SAR SE RIDA\nMAULA MAA UMMUL BANEEN SE MAT KEHNA
english translation text: BUT BY MY FALLING HOW THE VEIL OF ZAINAB FELL FROM HER HEAD\nOH MY MASTER, DON'T TELL MY MOTHER UMMUL BANEEN

arabic text: YE SOCH KE RAN MAY ROTI HAI, BAAZU SE LIPAT KAR MERI WAFA\nYE BAAT GARAN GUZREGI BAHOT, AMMA KI TABIYAT PAR AAQA
english translation text: THINKING OF THIS SHE CRIES IN THE BATTLEFIELD, MY LOYALTY\nHUGGING MY ARMS. THIS MATTER WILL HURT MY MOM A LOT

arabic text: GAR HAATH HUE PANI SE MERE, AUR AAP KA ASGHAR PYASA RAHA\nMAULA MAA UMMUL BANEEN SE MAT KEHNA
english translation text: THAT MY HANDS GOT WET WITH THE WATER, AND YOUR ASGHER REMAINED THIRSTY\nOH MY MASTER, DON'T TELL MY MOTHER UMMUL BANEEN
